description: This Swift source file defines the VoiceTab view for a SwiftUI-based iOS app. It displays the voice wake status, listener state, notes on wake words, and allows toggling voice wake and talk modes.

classes.name: VoiceTab
classes.description: A SwiftUI View representing the Voice tab in the app's UI, managing voice wake and talk modes, and displaying related status information.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Builds the SwiftUI view hierarchy for the Voice tab, including sections for status and notes, and reacts to changes in voice wake and talk modes.
